name: Anime.js
summary: All-in-one JavaScript animation engine: one API for DOM, SVG and CSS animations, timelines, scroll and draggable elements.
description: A lightweight, modular JavaScript animation library (the animejs npm package, from v4.0.0) for animating the web with a single animate() API. It ships timelines, easing and spring functions, a Scroll Observer for scroll-synchronised animation, a stagger utility, an SVG toolset for shape morphing, line drawing and motion paths, and a Draggable API, with full documentation, an easing editor and examples.
contains: single animate() API with per-property parameters and keyframes
Timeline API for sequencing and playback control
Scroll Observer API for scroll-triggered animations
SVG utilities: shape morphing, line drawing, motion paths
stagger utility: time, values and timeline positions
Draggable API with snap, flick and throw
Scope API for media-query responsive animations
